question: The last Mughal Emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar was imprisoned in Rangoon jail by the British in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1858**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bahadur Shah Zafar was the last Mughal Emperor** who participated and was a **symbolic head of the Revolt of 1857**.

 
 
• He was born on **24 October 1775**.
 
• He** became Emperor** in **1837 at the age of 62**.
 
• He** succeeded** his father, **Emperor Akbar Shah II**.
 
• He was also a **poet**.
 
 
 
• After the **revolt of 1857**, he was found guilty and **sent to exile in Burma (present Myanmar)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** **__**Revolt of 1857**-​__

 
• The **revolt of 1857 started due** to the **British policy of Doctrine of lapse, High land revenue, higher taxation and mistreatment of Indian sepoys**.
 
• It was the **1st major revolt that took place against Britisher** and was also called as** First War of Independence by V.D.Sawarkar**.
